---

The approved brief.json:

{"version":1,"audience":"Developers new to the team","takeaway":"Nothing reaches staging unless the lint, the tests and the build all pass.","shape":"zoom"}

---

Write storyboard.json for this:

Write the script for this flow: Explain our CI pipeline: a developer pushes a branch to GitHub, GitHub Actions runs the lint, the tests and a build in parallel, and when all pass it publishes a Docker image to the registry and deploys it to staging.

{"storyboard":{"version":1,"scenes":[{"id":"whole_system","title":"The pipeline at a glance","nodes":["dev","github","actions","lint","tests","build","gate","registry","staging"],"beats":[{"id":"push","caption":"A developer pushes a branch.","say":"Every change starts when a developer pushes a branch to GitHub.","actions":[{"type":"appear","node":"dev"},{"type":"appear","node":"github"},{"type":"flow","edge":"push","label":"push branch"}]},{"id":"trigger","caption":"GitHub Actions starts the pipeline.","say":"GitHub sends a webhook, and Actions starts the pipeline.","actions":[{"type":"appear","node":"actions"},{"type":"flow","edge":"trigger","label":"webhook"}]},{"id":"checks","caption":"Three checks run side by side.","say":"Lint, the tests and a build all run at the same time.","actions":[{"type":"appear","node":"lint"},{"type":"appear","node":"tests"},{"type":"appear","node":"build"},{"type":"flow","edge":"run_lint","label":"run"},{"type":"flow","edge":"run_tests","label":"run"},{"type":"flow","edge":"run_build","label":"run"}]},{"id":"gather","caption":"The results meet at a gate.","say":"Each check reports back to a single gate that asks whether all passed.","actions":[{"type":"appear","node":"gate"},{"type":"flow","edge":"lint_done","label":"pass"},{"type":"flow","edge":"tests_done","label":"pass"},{"type":"flow","edge":"build_done","label":"pass"}]},{"id":"reach_staging","caption":"Only a full pass reaches staging.","say":"When every check passes, the image is published and deployed to staging.","actions":[{"type":"appear","node":"registry"},{"type":"appear","node":"staging"},{"type":"flow","edge":"publish","label":"push image"},{"type":"flow","edge":"deploy","label":"deploy image"},{"type":"badge","node":"staging","text":"live","tone":"ok"}]}]},{"id":"the_gate","title":"The gate","nodes":["actions","lint","tests","build","gate","registry","staging"],"beats":[{"id":"each_check","caption":"Each check must pass.","say":"Lint, the tests and the build each report pass or fail.","actions":[{"type":"highlight","node":"lint"},{"type":"highlight","node":"tests"},{"type":"highlight","node":"build"},{"type":"callout","node":"gate","title":"All three","text":"Every check must pass before the gate opens."}]},{"id":"one_failure","caption":"One failure stops the release.","say":"If any check fails, the gate stays shut and nothing is published.","actions":[{"type":"dim","except":["gate","lint","tests","build"]},{"type":"badge","node":"gate","text":"blocked","tone":"error"}]},{"id":"full_pass","caption":"A full pass publishes the image.","say":"When all three pass, the image goes to the registry and then to staging.","actions":[{"type":"dim","except":["gate","registry","staging"]},{"type":"flow","edge":"publish","label":"push image"},{"type":"flow","edge":"deploy","label":"deploy image"},{"type":"badge","node":"gate","text":"all passed","tone":"ok"}]}]}]},"titleCard":{"title":"Nothing reaches staging unless every check passes","description":"How our CI pipeline guards each deploy."},"assumptions":["The audience is developers new to the team, so the story names GitHub Actions and the registry without explaining them further.","The shape is zoom: the first scene shows the whole pipeline, and the second looks closely at the gate that decides whether a deploy happens.","The gate opens only when lint, tests and build all pass, as the brief's takeaway says; the graph's edges are read as pass-only paths.","The narration treats publish and deploy as one step once the gate opens, since the graph shows them as consecutive."]}

Everything but these nodes fades back from here to the next dim or the next beat without one; a dim in a scene's last beat holds to its end.

notes.description: The author's own notes; never shown.

assumptions.description: What you assumed where the description left it open, each in a sentence.
